name: No Article 52 letter when the EES figure matches the trips

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?scenario=near-limit (demo history read on 2026-10-19; banner data-testid=scenario-banner)
Click 'Letter' in the top navigation (data-testid=nav-letter). Do not type a URL

Fill Full name 'Jane Traveller' (data-testid=letter-name), Date of birth 1990-05-04 (letter-birth), Country of nationality 'Egypt' (letter-nationality), Travel document number 'A1234567' (letter-document), Email 'jane@example.com' (letter-email) and Member State 'France' (letter-member-state)
Enter 88 in the EES days used field (data-testid=letter-ees-days), the same figure as the trips
The form message (data-testid=letter-error) contains 'nothing to correct'
